from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class StrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        # Market-state quantities are updated whenever their own bar is present.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            if aapl_bar.Close < aapl_bar.Open:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # No rule evaluation unless every subscribed ticker has today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # All rule inputs must be fully formed before any trade is allowed.
        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or self.aapl_red_streak < 3:
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        current_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= previous_spy_sma and
            float(spy_bar.Close) > current_spy_sma
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= previous_spy_sma and
            float(spy_bar.Close) < current_spy_sma
        )

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and not self.strategy_a_pending and spy_crosses_below:
            self.strategy_a_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot, "StrategyA")

        if (self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and not self.strategy_b_pending and
                float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60):
            self.strategy_b_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot, "StrategyB")

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and not self.strategy_a_pending and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = int(math.floor(
                0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / float(spy_bar.Close)
            ))
            if shares > 0:
                self.strategy_a_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares, "StrategyA")

        if (self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and not self.strategy_b_pending and
                self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000):
            shares = int(math.floor(20000.0 / float(aapl_bar.Close)))
            if shares > 0:
                self.strategy_b_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares, "StrategyB")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Tag == "StrategyA":
            if orderEvent.FillQuantity != 0:
                self.strategy_a_lot = max(
                    0, self.strategy_a_lot + int(orderEvent.FillQuantity)
                )

            if orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.strategy_a_pending = False

        elif orderEvent.Tag == "StrategyB":
            if orderEvent.FillQuantity != 0:
                self.strategy_b_lot = max(
                    0, self.strategy_b_lot + int(orderEvent.FillQuantity)
                )

            if orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.strategy_b_pending = False

                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.spy_sma_values = RollingWindow[float](2)

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(spy_bar.Close))

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.spy_sma_values.Add(float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close)

            if aapl_bar.Close < aapl_bar.Open:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                self.spy_closes.Count < 2 or
                self.spy_sma_values.Count < 2 or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close_today = self.spy_closes[0]
        spy_close_yesterday = self.spy_closes[1]

        spy_sma_yesterday = self.spy_sma_values[1]

        spy_crosses_above_sma = (
            spy_close_yesterday <= spy_sma_yesterday and
            spy_close_today > spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below_sma = (
            spy_close_yesterday >= spy_sma_yesterday and
            spy_close_today < spy_sma_today
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below_sma:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above_sma:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close_today)
            if shares > 0:
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                if ticket.Status != OrderStatus.Invalid:
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    if ticket.Status != OrderStatus.Invalid:
                        self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        prior_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close

        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            if aapl_bar.Close < aapl_bar.Open:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1

                    if quantity > 0:

                if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = 0

                if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                    shares = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_bar.Close)
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = shares

                if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                    if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                        shares = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                        if shares > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                            self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
